专车一路疾驰，穿山越省，昼夜兼程。

两日之后，抵达江南魔都近郊，一处隐于山林之间的隐秘建筑群。这里没有任何显眼标识，外围布下多重隐匿阵法与警戒防线，寻常人就算路过，也只会以为是一处普通山间度假村。

这里，正是749局江南总部分部，专门负责召集、收纳、管控全国各地异能者、宗门修士、奇人异士的核心据点。

车子驶入阵法结界之内，眼前景象骤然一变，亭台楼阁错落有致，安保人员气息沉稳，往来之人个个身怀异术，气质不凡，有修士、有异能者、有蛊师、有暗器高手，形形色色，汇聚于此。

下车之后，林佳领着胡九郎与范梦雪走入主楼大厅。

大厅宽敞恢弘，装修简约肃穆，四周立着隐秘的聚灵阵法，空气中灵气浓郁。此刻大厅内已经聚集了不少人，三三两两聚在一起，低声交谈，气息各异，气场慑人。

“这里就是749局专项行动小队的集结地。”林佳轻声介绍，“总局筛选了全国顶尖战力，一共七位核心成员，加上我八位，组成专门奔赴东北对抗东瀛三派的特战小队。”

胡九郎目光缓缓扫过大厅众人，神识悄然散开，将每个人的修为、路子一眼看穿。

有练气修士，有先天异能，有旁门秘术，个个都不是泛泛之辈。

就在这时，两道身影并肩走来，一冷一俏，气质截然不同。

为首女子一身劲装，身姿高挑，面容清冷，眉眼带着几分生人勿近的锐利，腰间暗藏暗器机关，周身萦绕着淬毒与潜行的阴冷气息，一看便是常年游走暗处、擅长暗杀布局的高手。

她身后跟着一名娇俏少女，眉眼灵动，活泼俏皮，眼神灵动狡黠，浑身透着机灵劲儿，手里把玩着一枚银色小飞镖，看似贪玩，实则暗藏杀机。

正是唐门嫡传双姝，王欣欣与茉沫。

王欣欣目光落在胡九郎和范梦雪身上，微微颔首，语气干练清冷：“唐门王欣欣，这位是我师妹茉沫。久闻龙虎山胡师兄、神霄范师姐大名，今日有幸同队，往后还请多多配合。”

胡九郎微微点头示意，范梦雪也礼貌回礼。

茉沫眨着大眼睛，好奇打量着胡九郎，小声嘀咕：“原来这就是九郎师兄啊，看着好冷，跟冰山似的。”

王欣欣瞪了她一眼，茉沫立刻吐了吐舌头，乖乖闭嘴。

唐门一脉，精通暗器、机关、毒术、潜行追踪，最擅长山林暗杀、布设陷阱、打探情报，正好适合东北复杂山林地形，对付甲贺忍的潜行幻术，再合适不过。

几人刚打过招呼，大厅另一侧，一道温婉柔和的身影缓缓走来。

女子一身浅黄长裙，气质温婉娴静，周身萦绕着淡淡的金石灵气，双手虚抬之间，隐隐有细碎金属微粒环绕流转，眼神温柔却透着坚韧。

正是西部御物一脉传人，李安琪。

“见过各位师兄师姐。”李安琪声音轻柔，待人谦和有礼，“我乃西部御物门李安琪，擅长御使金石兵器、构筑防御结界、操控灵材器物，往后队内防御、物资守护，可交由我来。”

御物一脉，得天独厚，能引山川金石之力为己用，可筑高墙、可凝兵器、可布防御，是团队中不可或缺的防御核心。

The special car galloped all the way through mountains and provinces, traveling day and night.

Two days later, we arrived at a secret building complex hidden among the mountains and forests on the outskirts of Jiangnan Magic City.There are no conspicuous signs here, and multiple concealment formations and warning lines are set up around the perimeter. Even if ordinary people pass by, they will only think it is an ordinary mountain resort.

This is the Jiangnan headquarters branch of Bureau 749, the core base responsible for convening, collecting, and controlling superpowers, sect monks, and strange people from all over the country.

The car drove into the formation barrier, and the scene in front of me suddenly changed. Pavilions and pavilions were scattered in an orderly manner, and the security personnel had a calm atmosphere. Everyone who came and went had strange skills and extraordinary temperament. There were monks, people with supernatural powers, Gu masters, and hidden weapon masters. All kinds of people gathered here.

After getting off the car, Lin Jia led Hu Jiulang and Fan Mengxue into the lobby of the main building.

The hall is spacious and grand, with simple and solemn decoration. There are secret spirit gathering formations around it, and the air is rich in spiritual energy.At this moment, many people have gathered in the hall, gathering in twos and threes, chatting in low voices, with different breaths and an intimidating aura.

"This is the gathering place for the 749 Bureau's special operations team." Lin Jia introduced softly, "The General Administration selected the top combat forces in the country. A total of seven core members, plus eight of me, formed a special operations team that went to the Northeast to fight against the three Japanese factions."

Hu Jiulang's eyes slowly swept across the people in the hall, and his consciousness quietly spread out, seeing through everyone's cultivation and path at a glance.

There are Qi-training monks, some have innate abilities, and some have side secret techniques. None of them are just ordinary people.

At this moment, two figures walked side by side, one cold and the other pretty, with completely different temperaments.

The leading woman was dressed in a smart outfit, tall and tall, with a cold face, and her eyebrows were a bit sharp as to avoid being approached by strangers. There was a hidden weapon mechanism hidden in her waist, and there was a cold aura of poisoning and stealth around her. At first glance, she was a master who had been traveling in dark places all year round and was good at assassination plans.

Behind her was a pretty girl with lively and playful eyebrows and cunning eyes. She was full of intelligence. She was playing with a small silver dart in her hand. She seemed to be playful, but actually she had a murderous intention.

It is the two direct descendants of the Tang clan, Wang Xinxin and Momo.

Wang Xinxin's eyes fell on Hu Jiulang and Fan Mengxue, she nodded slightly, and said in a cool and capable tone: "Wang Xinxin of the Tang Sect, this is my junior sister Momo. I have heard about the names of Senior Sister Hu and Senior Sister Shenxiao Fan of Longhu Mountain for a long time. I am honored to be on the same team today. Please cooperate with me in the future."

Hu Jiulang nodded slightly, and Fan Mengxue responded politely.

Momo blinked her big eyes, looked at Hu Jiulang curiously, and whispered softly: "So this is Senior Brother Jiulang. He looks so cold, like an iceberg."

Wang Xinxin glared at her, and Momo immediately stuck out her tongue and shut up obediently.

The Tang clan's lineage is proficient in hidden weapons, traps, poison techniques, and stealth tracking. They are best at mountain forest assassinations, laying traps, and gathering intelligence. They are suitable for the complex mountainous terrain of the Northeast and are perfect for dealing with the stealth illusions of Koga Ninja.

A few people had just said hello when a gentle and gentle figure came slowly from the other side of the hall.

The woman was wearing a light yellow dress, with a gentle and demure temperament. There was a faint aura of gold and stone lingering around her body. Between her raised hands, there were faint metal particles circulating around her. Her eyes were gentle but showed tenacity.

It is none other than Li Anqi, a descendant of the Western Royal Monument lineage.

"I have met all the senior brothers and sisters." Li Anqi's voice was soft, and she was courteous and courteous. "I am Li Anqi of the Western Royal Object Sect. I am good at using gold and stone weapons, building defensive barriers, and controlling spiritual materials. You can leave the defense and material protection of the team to me in the future."

The Yuwu lineage is uniquely endowed with the ability to harness the power of mountains, rivers, metals, and stones for its own use. It can build high walls, condense weapons, and lay out defenses. It is an indispensable defensive core in the team.
